name: Iliotibial Band Stretch
description: Stretches the band of tissue along the outside of the hip and thigh: cross one ankle over the other and reach that arm overhead toward the other side.

source.title: Mayo Clinic: A guide to basic stretches

setup: Stand near a wall or sturdy support for balance.
Cross your left leg over your right at the ankle.
cues: Reach up and over toward your right side.
You'll feel it along the outside of your left hip.
Keep your weight steady; use the wall.

prescription.note: Hold about 30 seconds and repeat 2 to 4 times on each side. Warm up for 5 to 10 minutes first, move slowly, don't bounce, and back off if it hurts.

keyframes.name: Cross your ankles
keyframes.cue: Left leg crossed over the right at the ankle, right hand on the wall.

keyframes.name: Reach over
keyframes.cue: Reach your left arm overhead toward your right side.
